== Summary ==
Slip “•IG-88’s Pulse Cannon” cut unchanged from page 6 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 75, 1624, 360)). Version [[IG-88's Pulse Cannon (V)#Source formats|IG-88's Pulse Cannon (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
